//: `workspace: []` makes this example its own Deno workspace root: it sits inside the denext repo without being a member, and the esbuild deno-loader refuses a nested non-member config. An app in its own repo does not need it. The lint rule no-sloppy-imports is off: Expo's source imports without extensions, which sloppy imports resolve as Metro does.

tasks.cap:sync: deno task export && node_modules/.bin/cap sync ios
tasks.ios: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination generic/platform=iOS -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData -jobs 2 -allowProvisioningUpdates DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=$DENEXT_IOS_TEAM build
tasks.ios:check: xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination generic/platform=iOS -derivedDataPath ios/DerivedData -jobs 2 CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
